Subject (in full) Arrival of Mr. Hisao Furuya, officer designate
of "E" Division.

Made by D. S. Kamashita Forwarded by D. I. Crawford.

Mr. Hisao Furuya, who has been designated
for the post of Divisional Officer of "E" Division,
arrived in Shanghai on board the m.v. Tatuta
Maru on April 28.

编号 S. B. D. 7985
日期 1940年4月29日

事由（全称）：“E”区候任警官古谷久雄先生抵沪。

呈报人：D. S. Kamashita 转呈人：D. I. Crawford。

被指定担任“E”区区警官一职的古谷久雄（Hisao Furuya）先生，于4月28日乘“龙田丸”号（m.v. Tatuta Maru）抵达上海。

D. S. Kamashita
